bio: When Demon Lord Atraxinoth came for his daughter, Lisena, Ulsos saw true darkness – but found true clarity. He donned his ancestral Dark Star armor in the crypts beneath his manor, and pursued Atraxinoth into the Void – where he still roams to this day, ensuring Atraxinoth and his kind pay tenfold.
